items.headline: Sony Music and Warner Chappell Sue Anthropic Over Claude's Training Data
items.summary: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music filed a lawsuit accusing Anthropic of illegally downloading tens of thousands of copyrighted songs (think Mariah Carey and Taylor Swift tracks) to train Claude, without permission or payment. Anthropic says it disagrees and will fight the case in court.
items.why_it_matters: This doesn't change how you use Claude today, but it's a reminder that the legal ground under AI tools is still shifting. If you use any AI tool to help write, arrange, or produce music, it's worth double-checking that tool's licensing terms before you publish or sell something built with it.

items.headline: Google Starts Replacing Google Assistant With Gemini on Android, September 4
items.summary: Starting September 4, Google begins swapping out the old Google Assistant for Gemini on Android phones, tablets, watches, and earbuds. The rollout happens automatically over a few weeks, and once your device switches over there's no way to go back to the old Assistant.
items.why_it_matters: If you or your viewers use an Android phone's voice assistant for quick tasks (setting timers, texting hands-free, checking the weather), the way it responds is about to change with no opt-out, so it's worth trying Gemini's voice mode once it appears rather than being caught off guard.

opportunity.action_note: If you rely on Google Assistant on an Android phone, spend five minutes with Gemini's voice mode once it rolls out to your device so the switch on September 4 doesn't catch you mid-task.

items.headline: OpenAI's Sora Video Tool Fully Shuts Down September 24, Grab Your Files Now
items.summary: OpenAI is closing the door on Sora, its AI video generator, for good: the app already went dark in April, and the last piece, the developer API that some other apps plug into, stops working on September 24. After that, OpenAI deletes all associated Sora account data.
items.why_it_matters: If you ever made clips with Sora, or if a video tool you use pulls in Sora under the hood, download anything you want to keep before September 24 or it's gone for good.

opportunity.action_note: Log into any Sora account you have and download the clips you want to keep before the API and remaining account data are deleted on September 24.
